The SVG below places each part with one transform. I measured the attachment points from the path coordinates, so they are approximate, but well inside the 6 px tolerances.

**Part placements**

- **Base**
  - Kept upright with no rotation.
  - Its centre-tab top edge is centred at local (234.35, 5), which lands at (688, 625).
- **Pillar**
  - The flat-bar end is the foot and the round knob end is the top.
  - The pillar's axis runs at 20° in the stored drawing, so I rotated it −110° to stand it vertical.
  - The foot bottom edge, local (21.1, 57.2), sits on the base tab at (688, 625).
  - This puts the top collar centre, the larger bar just under the knob, at about (688, 170).
- **Beam**
  - The pivot hole, local (213.56, 235.83), is on the collar at (688, 170).
  - Rotating it −54.9° makes it symmetric, with the ends drooping and the end hooks opening upward.
  - This puts the end curls at about (426.4, 206.9) and (949.0, 206.8).
- **Pointer**
  - The hub hole, local (239.35, 170.87), is on the pivot.
  - Rotated −124.86° so the needle hangs straight down along the pillar.
  - **Assumption:** the needle could point down or up; I chose down because pointing up would run far above the knob.
- **Left stirrup**
  - Rotated −160° so the hook is at the top.
  - The midpoint between its hook curl and rod hole, local (148.9, 269.1), is on the left beam curl.
  - Its U-cradle inner bottom then lands at about (426.7, 464.2).
- **Right stirrup**
  - Rotated −25° so the hook is at the top.
  - The hook–hole midpoint, local (160, 35.95), is on the right beam curl.
  - Its cradle bottom then lands at about (949, 465.3).
- **Left pan**
  - Rotated −35° so the rim is horizontal on top.
  - Its foot bottom edge under the centre tab, local (115.44, 141.99), is on the left cradle.
- **Right pan**
  - Rotated −70° so the rim is horizontal on top.
  - Its foot bottom edge under the centre tab, local (46.35, 173.0), is on the right cradle.
